verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, and a built-in AI assistant in its dashboard or docs is a fair question for this kind of SaaS product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only payment APIs, payment links, POS, refunds and similar features, with no built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to. The llms.txt probe shows docs formatted for external AI tools, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
